# Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation

← Back to topic

**Authors:** OpenAI, Marcin Andrychowicz, Bowen Baker, Maciek Chociej, Rafal Jozefowicz, Bob McGrew, Jakub Pachocki, Arthur Petron, et al.  
**Year:** 2019  
**Journal:** Nature  
**DOI:** [10.1038/s41586-019-1733-9](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-019-1733-9)  
**Publisher:** [https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-019-1733-9](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-019-1733-9)

**Keywords:** robotics, reinforcement learning, manipulation

## Abstract

We use reinforcement learning to learn dexterous in-hand manipulation policies which can be deployed on a physical robot.
